attributes.readMe:
## Compute SLA Deadline

PURE: reads start + target + SLA Window (+ pause minutes), writes nothing, returns the wall-clock deadline. The calendar work is utils/sla.addBusinessMinutes — DST-safe via Intl in the window's own zone, shared with Apply SLA Policy, so one implementation serves both desks. Pauses are wall-clock: the deadline moves out by exactly the pause.

### Non-goals

Never writes a timer (the lifecycle commands stamp deadlineAt); never selects a policy (the caller chooses, per the apply-sla-policy precedent).

attributes.cardDescription: Turns a start time, a target in business minutes and an SLA window into the wall-clock deadline, counting only open hours.
